full_text:
ATTACHED TABLE — Rules on Imposition of Anti-Dumping Duties on Butyl Glycol Ether Originating in the United States of America and France

Anti-Dumping Duty Rates by Supplier of Goods Subject to Imposition (Related to Article 3)

Country of supply | Supplier | Anti-dumping duty rate (%)
United States of America | Dow Chemical Company and persons exporting products of that company | 25.00
United States of America | Eastman Chemical Company and persons exporting products of that company | 25.00
United States of America | All other suppliers | 25.00
France | INEOS and persons exporting products of that company | 20.10
France | All other suppliers | 20.10

The original Korean table visually merges duty-rate cells across the suppliers listed for each country. This draft enumerates the suppliers individually while retaining the shared percentage rates.
